reconcile.note: Clarke argues the ark's keel grounded on a submerged peak while the waters still covered the visible mountaintops, so resting preceded the tops becoming visible.

sides.snippet: The ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat's mountains.
sides.verseText: The ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat's mountains.

sides.snippet: In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were seen.
sides.verseText: The waters receded continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were seen.
